differences.title: 1. Architecture
differences.leftDesc: Redpanda consolidates brokers, Zookeeper, and schema registry into a single binary for simplified operations and reduced resource overhead.
differences.rightDesc: Kafka traditionally relies on Zookeeper for metadata management, adding operational complexity and a separate failure domain to the cluster.

differences.title: 2. Performance
differences.leftDesc: Redpanda achieves lower latency through its vectorized execution engine, WASM transforms, and direct integration with storage layers.
differences.rightDesc: Kafka excels at massive throughput by leveraging batching and distributed log append-only structures, optimizing for data volume.

differences.title: 3. Data Ingestion
differences.leftDesc: Redpanda integrates a schema registry directly, enforcing schema validation and evolution at ingestion time within the broker itself.
differences.rightDesc: Kafka typically requires a separate Schema Registry (like Confluent's) to manage and enforce schemas for producers and consumers.

differences.title: 4. Programming Model
differences.leftDesc: Redpanda supports in-place data transformation using WebAssembly (WASM) modules, enabling efficient, stateful stream processing within the broker.
differences.rightDesc: Kafka Streams provides a Java-based DSL for building stream processing applications, requiring separate application deployments.

differences.title: 5. API Compatibility
differences.leftDesc: Redpanda offers a 100% Kafka wire-compatible API, allowing seamless migration and use of existing Kafka clients and tools without modification.
differences.rightDesc: Kafka's API is the de facto standard, with a vast ecosystem of clients and tools built around its protocol.

differences.title: 6. Operational Complexity
differences.leftDesc: Redpanda's single binary and built-in components drastically reduce deployment and management overhead, making it easier to operate.
differences.rightDesc: Operating Kafka, especially with Zookeeper, involves managing multiple distributed systems, increasing operational burden and failure points.

differences.title: 7. Ecosystem Integration
differences.leftDesc: Leveraging Kafka compatibility, Redpanda works with existing Kafka clients, connectors, and frameworks, offering broad integration from day one.
differences.rightDesc: Kafka's maturity has fostered an enormous ecosystem of tools, connectors, and client libraries across numerous programming languages.
